mainEntity.name: What is an entertainment travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: An entertainment travel insurance plan provides comprehensive coverage for your trip, not just the expenses around the event you’re traveling for. Most travel insurance plans have comprehensive coverages to help protect almost every aspect of your trip. With entertainment travel, you’ll want to protect the costs that you paid for in advance in case of an unexpected event like sickness, severe weather, job loss or another covered event that could prevent you from traveling.

mainEntity.name: What does an entertainment travel insurance plan cover?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers several travel insurance plans that can help protect the pre-paid costs of your trip. Popular plan features include:

Trip Cancellation – If your travel plans are called off for a covered reason, you can file a claim to help get reimbursed for prepaid non-refundable costs.

Trip Delay – Don’t let an unexpected event prevent you from reaching your destination, Travel Guard can help get you back on track.

Baggage Delay – Depending on the length of delay, you may be able to get reimbursed for the costs of preplacing necessary personal items.

Medical expense coverage – If you’re traveling internationally, medical expense coverage is crucial since your U.S. medical healthcare may not provide coverage outside of the country.

Concierge Services – Looking for another ticket or a place to dine before the show? Our assistance services team can help make your trip even more special.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an entertainment trip travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a travel insurance plan for your entertainment or event specific vacation may not be mandatory for your trip, there are risks with travel that make booking coverage well worth it. With a travel insurance plan , you can get coverage for Trip Cancellation , Trip Delay , Travel Inconvenience and a variety of other coverages that can help protect your travel investment. Plus, you’ll have 24/7 access to our emergency travel assistance services team who can help in a crisis. And most plans give you access to our concierge services, such as restaurant recommendations, or you can even get help scoring tickets to nearby events.

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard travel insurance plan is best for my entertainment trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best travel insurance plan will depend on the amount of coverage you need and what your plans are on vacation. Many travelers start with the Preferred Plan since it has the most available optional upgrades to create the plan that’s best for you. For higher cost trips, the Deluxe Plan is a great option and already includes popular bundles like the Travel Inconvenience Bundle and the Baggage Bundle .
